about

St. Silva is the electro-acoustic musical project of Ben Dexter Cooley. The work spans multiple genres and embraces experimentation, drawing on influences from environmental music, neoclassical, and ambient.

You can find St. Silva on Instagram. For collaborations and booking, please email stsilvamusic@proton.me
